positive_snippets:
Services are appreciative. Staff is much helpful and sincere.
Food taste like homemade food.
You wouldn't regret booking this hotel.
Mr. Wazir (owner) & his manger, Mr Mahesh are very supportive.
I highly recommend this hotel.

Fabulous restaurant place  to sit is Excellent.  The Food is delicious there. They will provide Irani Dishes and other gulf dishes there. Mohit the owner of restaurant is very Polite and cooperative and nice person. Food is affordable it's not so Expensive there.  Starex Hotel is the best place to stay  in center of  Two big Hospitals  of Gurgaon......Artimis Hospital  & Medanta medicity Hospital is hardly 7km from there.,... Best connectivity for Food, Hospital and Metro there.....Moreover the Managing Director of  Hotel Mr Wazir Singh  is very Nice and  helpful and Cooperative person.
negative_snippets: Stayed there for a week, it was good n quite in the beginning but on weekend they allowed group of men n women to party n drink next to our rooms who made too much of loud noises.. we failed to understand if the occupancy of the hotel was almost 💯 patients n attendents how could they give rooms for such people who created so much of noise and inconvenience to everyone around.. it was completely unacceptable and therefore would not recommend if you want peaceful sleep during your stay..
Hotel’s location is amazing. Specially for people who are visiting Artemis Hospital. Rooms are average and sometimes below average as they are not well kept. Service is just ok. Overall kaam chalau!
I'm not writing this review about the hotel rooms but for the restaurant they have on the ground floor. Absolutely pathetic taste and service. Smelly seating area.
